inlines.v: LOG'-BOOK, noun A book into which are transcribed the contents of the log-board. LOG'-HOUSE, LOG'-HUT, noun A house or hut whose walls are composed of logs laid on each other. LOG'-LINE, noun A line or cord about a hundred and fifty fathoms in length, fastened to the log by means of two legs. This is wound on a reel, called the log-reel.
